route_intro_line_two: It does not have to be exact.

sigh.second_inhale_hint: a second small sip of air, on top
phrases: this is a spike, not a forecast
you don't have to solve this right now
you're allowed to just wait this out
nothing here needs deciding this second

anger.hint: fists, jaw, shoulders. As tight as you can.
anger.phrase: this is a spike, not a forecast

steps: Notice what your mind is doing. You do not have to argue with it.
Silently say: “I am noticing a difficult thought.”
Press both feet into the floor. Feel the pressure pushing back.
Find one thing you can see, one sound you can hear, and one sensation you can feel.
The thought can be here without deciding what you do next.
unhook.complete: You made a little room around the thought.

steps: Feel both feet making contact with the floor.
Lift your shoulders gently. Let them drop as you breathe out.
Unclench your jaw. Let your tongue rest.
Look at three stable objects around you. Nothing else needs doing right now.
reset.complete: You gave your system a moment to come down.
